labels.label: def:singular_spacetime
labels.notes: The row is unmarked and partial, which is correct. Neither file has a ``**`label`**`` mark in its first 4000 characters. The only bold backticked token there is **`stronglyCausal`** (E0Strong.lean:45). It has no `prefix:` form, so ledger.py's docstring_label_re cannot read it as a mark. def:singular_spacetime is cited unmarked at `ETT.tex:1500`, matching the ledger tex_span [1500, 1507]. The quoted paragraph (l.1501-1506) is verbatim. WITNESS. A probe confirms the types. `Causal.E0.singularFlatAxioms : Causal.E0.causality.SingularFlatAxioms Causal.E0.singE0` uses the strict structure Causal.Causality.SingularFlatAxioms from module Causal.SingularFlat. `singularFlatSpacetime` uses Causal.Causality.SingularFlatSpacetime from Causal.SingularGeroch. `globallyHyperbolic` uses Causal.Causality.GloballyHyperbolic from Causal.Properties, which is `IsCausal ∧ ∀ p q, IsCompact (diamond ⊤ p q)`, def:globally_hyperbolic verbatim. `causality` is the strict Causal.Port.E0Causality one. Neither file declares a structure, class or axiom. The only new defs are singE0 (`if α = 0 then axis else ∅`) and gx's own sector, Img, SliceAt, sliceDom and Loc* predicates. singularFlatAxioms takes no hypothesis: it is singularFlatAxioms_of_pushUp applied to E0LM.e0_pushUp, which is itself unconditional. singE0_zero_nonempty gives (0,0) ∈ sing₀, so the witness has a BTZ point. massive_line is vacuous only because sing_α = ∅ for α > 0. Every other field carries content: btzAxioms (audited in T-ett-port-e0), push-up, tarentin, Z±, closed sing₀ with empty interior. I found no other concrete instance with sing 0 nonempty in Causal/ or scaffold/, so E₀ is the first witness with a non-empty sing₀. READINGS. All three are disclosed. (1) E₀ per OQ-34/OQ-35, open. The statement that under the printed metric l.1330 the axis is timelike, so Iminus_eq_empty fails, is correct: that metric is Minkowski 3-space in cylindrical coordinates. (2) The abstraction has no atlas and no generated causality; that is the row's existing reason for partial. (3) An atlas need not use every model X_α. This reading is disclosed only as REPORT question 2. The checklist and the hypotheses row mark it ✓/carried (minor finding 1). The connectedness row is right: ConnectedSpace (ℝ × ℂ) by inferInstance. The applications at E₀ are the strict theorems instantiated with no extra hypothesis, apart from stronglyCausal and globallyHyperbolic, which are proved here: not_pastDistinguishing_of_singularFlatAxioms, K_injectif, K_densite_sing, K_ordre, past_BTZ_b (sing 0 rewritten to axis) and geroch_hypotheses_of_singularFlat. All touched rows are cited unmarked.

So the ported statements also mean what they meant in gx.

E0SingularFlat with LEAN_PATH prefixed by that fresh olean, under -DwarningAsError=true, exits 0. Plain `lake env lean -DwarningAsError=true` on each file from lean-causal/ also exits 0. As a control, a copy of E0Strong with one injected `sorry` fails as it should. `sorry` occurs once per file, in docstring prose ('no `sorry` in this file'). The union is {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}. All probes and oleans under /tmp were deleted. lake build was not run, per the dispatch.

But REPORT questions[1] treats it as a reading taken: def:singular_spacetime does not say whether an E^{1,2}_A-manifold must use every model X_α, and E₀ uses only X_0. kb/0006 reserves ✓ for a carried hypothesis. SCOPE (a) names only the OQ-34/OQ-35 readings, not this one. T-ett-port-e0 AUDIT-1 (minor 3) raised the same pattern.

findings.where: scaffold/CausalScaffold/Port/E0SingularFlat.lean:38-40 ('the only one before was the timelike line, sing = ∅') and :671-673 (docstring of exists_singularFlatSpacetime_sing_zero_nonempty: 'Until this theorem the only witness in the library was the timelike line')
findings.what: The 'only witness' claim is inaccurate. The strict Causal.Flat.flat_singularFlatAxioms (Causal/Flat/CBG.lean:367) proves (flatCausality d M).SingularFlatAxioms (chartedSing (fun _ => ∅) M) for every T2, connected, second-countable flat manifold. Its hypotheses include ConnectedSpace, so it also gives a SingularFlatSpacetime. So the abstraction already had a whole family of witnesses, all with sing = ∅. The substantive claim is true: E₀ is the first witness with sing₀ ≠ ∅, and I found no other instance with sing 0 nonempty. The sentence about the abstract theorems ('each one was witnessed on the timelike line only', l.692) is accurate for the explicit instantiations.
findings.fix: Write 'every earlier witness had sing = ∅ (the timelike line, timelikeLine_singularFlatSpacetime; every flat spacetime, Causal.Flat.flat_singularFlatAxioms)' at both places.
